topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got home from a long day, and what do I find on my doorstep? A package - not for me, but for the joker who used to live here. Great, just what I needed. Now I have to take the time to drag this back to the post office or figure out how to redirect it. I swear, since I moved in, it's been one thing after another. This neighborhood, the neighbors, and now this. I’m not even sure why I bother. I suppose I’ll have to call the sender and let them know they've got the wrong address. Can't a person catch a break around here?
